title: scenario-record contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-822). The validation summary of one ScenarioRecord (schema:1) banked in the nine-scenario Phase 0 reference matrix. The record itself is emitted by the pure `faff scenario-matrix record` emitter; this contract re-validates its shape and the honest-claim invariants: schema:1, the required fields present, disposition in the nine-value enum, effect_class E-B only when disposition is blocked, journal_class at most J-C on a producer-HMAC leg, organisational_independence always false, and one_shot_control non-null iff the ordinal is one of {2,3,5,6}. Named off 'audit' so the record never clashes with ADR-0123's `commissaire audit` governance-evidence object.

disposition.description: One of {accepted, blocked, refused, recovered, denied, detected, parked, amended, corrected}; a non-enum value from a malformed record is echoed as the empty string and flagged in `violations` (exit 1), never a schema fail-loud.

journal_class.description: One of {J-A, J-B, J-C, J-D}; empty when a malformed record carried no valid assurance_vector — flagged in `violations`, not a schema fail-loud.

effect_class.description: One of {E-A, E-B, E-C, E-D}; empty when a malformed record carried no valid assurance_vector — flagged in `violations`, not a schema fail-loud.
